# Checkout
## Problem
Buyers abandon the cart because the checkout asks for data twice.
## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] AC1 Given a filled cart, when I pay, then the address is asked once
## Out of scope
Gift cards.
## Security and privacy
Not applicable: payment is handled by the provider's hosted page.
## Design
Calm and quick; touches the cart and payment screens. System: [docs/design/system.md](../../design/system.md).
